text: Chiriku empowers the spear with golden chakra, similar to that emitted by Welcoming Approach: Thousand-Armed Murder, and attacks the opponent several times before piercing them with a spear throw.

Boruto creates four shadow clones, one of which launches itself at the opponent, kicking them. The second shadow clone jumps in to continue the assault with a Gentle Fist attack, after which the three other clones attack simultaneously with a series of attacks, launching their opponent into the air with a defence-breaking combo attack. The real Boruto then creates his version of Rasengan and, with the help of the clones, jumps into the air and throws the Rasengan at the opponent. pt-br:Golpe Boruto ru:Удар Боруто
Gengetsu jumps and creates a few water bullets, shooting the opponent with them in quick succession.
After kneading chakra in her mouth, Mei converts it into water before expelling from her mouth in the form a whip, which she uses to lash at her opponent, sending them flying back.

Kidōmaru spreads a network of "touch threads" throughout an area. Kidōmaru constantly sends his chakra along the threads, allowing him to sense anything that comes into contact with them; the threads are sensitive enough to even detect slight disturbances in the air. Because the threads appear no different than normal spiderwebs, they aren't likely to be noticed and thus are effective as an alert of approaching enemies. Kidōmaru uses this technique while he and the rest of the Sound Four are resting, ensuring they won't be ambushed. The touch threads, being stronger than wire, can also be used to reel in those who've contacted them.

Before this technique can be performed, the user's body must first be modified to increase its flexibility and elasticity. Once this is done, the user can stretch and bend their body however and whenever they please, extending it to great lengths and retracting it again. This is done by dislocating their joints and then using chakra to manipulate their body's shape. The technique was originally developed for intelligence gathering so that users could squeeze into smalls spaces. In combat, users can wrap around targets to restrain or constrict them, or strike at them with their limbs, the limbs' length making them similar to whips.

Hayate creates several shadow clones that attack the enemy with their swords. During this time, he himself becomes invisible, allowing him to launch a surprise attack at the right moment, even if the clones are destroyed. pl:Tajemny Miecz: Płynący Cień

Shikamaru is able to utilise his shadow to crack the ground around him, possessing nearby opponent. The shadow will spin, forming a small whirlwind, attacking possessed and approaching opponent. es:Técnica de la Red de Sombra pt-br:Técnica da Rede das Sombras

Gaara can form a sand pillar using the sand from the ground or by warping the lower half of his body into sand. Gaara manipulates the sand to suspend and manoeuvres himself in mid-air at high speeds. The sand maintains contact with the ground, thus creating a pillar-like formation.

Sakon and Ukon's unnamed kekkei genkai gives them the unique ability to break their bodies down to a molecular level. The two brothers usually use this ability to share the same body by fusing their cells but can also use it to merge with the bodies of others and destroy the host's cells from the inside. When Sakon is in need of assistance, Ukon can bring out some of his body parts to aid Sakon in blocking or attacking. Ukon's arms and legs can emerge from those of Sakon's to increase the force and quantity to his physical attacks. Yagura knocks the opponent underwater, before transforming into Isobu. While transformed as Isobu, he rams the opponent out of the water, and finishes them off by spitting a stream of water directly at them.
Haku delivers a string of kicks, punches, and senbon slashes to his opponent, throws them up in the air while performing a back flip, and jumps higher than his opponent to throw senbon at them.
Jūgo grows many jet-like appendages to propel himself towards his opponent, and lands a series of punches and swipes.

Kurenai attacks her opponent with a combination of an elbow blow and two kicks before releasing a breath of cherry blossom petals that burst at the opponent, bombarding them. es:Caída de la Flor de Albaricoque pl:Anshōsui

An enderman is a neutral mob found in all three dimensions that has a chance of dropping ender pearls when it is killed. It becomes hostile to players that damage it or look directly at its face, using its arms to attack. Endermen teleport erratically, as well as away from dangers such as lava, projectiles, and water. They also occasionally pick up and move certain blocks.

Bea is a minor NPC character who appears in Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope. She is a female bee-Rabbid hybrid and is the warden of Terra Flora who lives inside the Everbloom Tree. Bea was formerly a famous singer of many genres, and was the Phantom's girlfriend. She was dumped via text message, and Bea's singing career ended. She then moved to Terra Flora to become an organic farmer. Bea is a bee-Rabbid hybrid with the body of a bee, and has the head, arms, and feet of a Rabbid. She has the ability to fly, due to her bee wings. Bea has black hair with pigtails, having a flower on top of her hair. She has yellow-brown eyes with long black eyelashes. Beezos, also known as Shy Aways in the original version of Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars, are a species of Shy Guys that first appeared in Super Mario Bros. 2. Beezos use bidents as weapons and have insect-like wings on their back, which allow them to fly. The name is likely a portmanteau of "bee" and "bozo".
Ghost Piranhas (also referred to as Polterpiranhas, or Ghosts in the Super Smash Bros. series) are winged, cobalt blue, undead Piranha Plants found in Yoshi's Island DS.

Wigglevines are a plant-like species, which first appear in Donkey Kong Country Returns and its Nintendo 3DS and Nintendo Switch ports. They only appear in the Forest world. In fact, their only appearance is in the level Wigglevine Wonders, where they play a major role in assisting Donkey Kong and Diddy Kong. As their name suggests, Wigglevines are organic plant-like creatures, which have a hanging vine attached to them. They are also capable of flying, and come in different sizes. The Kongs can grab hold of a Wigglevine's vine, and it will carry them. The large Wigglevines can handle the Kongs' weight, and carry them past large pits. The small Wigglevines, however, can only handle the Kongs

Valkyries are Rabbid enemies in Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle. They wear armor equipped with breastplate mounted machine guns that destroy Mega Blocks and inflict multiple hits on their targets. Like Hoppers, they can perform Team Jumps; however, their jumps end with a Ground Pound that can damage anyone within range of their landing. They are also capable of using the Protection Technique to shield allies, reducing the damage inflicted to them by absorbing some of it themselves. The introductory cutscene starts with the characters strolling through the area, where they get confused when bullets getting shot everywhere around them form a heart shape. A Tweeter Bat is a furred and bat-winged type of Tweeter; like a vampire, it has two pronounced fangs in its beak, which it uses to suck tomato sauce up with. In The Super Mario Bros. Super Show! episode "Count Koopula," Count Koopula sends a Tweeter Bat out to lure Mario, Luigi, Toad and Princess Toadstool to his castle. Upon receiving its orders, this Tweeter Bat flies towards Mario, Luigi, Toad and Princess Toadstool; upon seeing Mario with a box of spaghetti, the Tweeter Bat grabs it in its talons and begins to fly away with it, towards Count Koopula's castle, despite Mario, Luigi, Toad and Princess Toadstool's attempts to stop it. Scorchits (also dubbed Zeus Guys) are a type of Snifit only appearing in Yoshi's Island DS. Scorchits can fire four balls of fire that harm Yoshi, and can melting unbreakable ice that even Baby Bowser cannot reach. Some Scorchits only shoot forwards, while others will swing their stream of fire upwards and downwards. Unlike most other types of Shy Guys in Yoshi's Island DS, Scorchits have a many-framed walking animation similar to their counterpart from Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island, but are only seen walks while on platforms only slightly wider than themselves, where they essentially just turn around. When on larger amounts of ground, they stand in place instead. They appear in the Is

Robobees are enemies from Donkey Kong Country Returns and Donkey Kong Country Returns 3D. They are robotic creatures resembling bees that constantly emit electricity, only found in the level Perilous Passage. In the level, the Kongs encounter the Robobees during the second section. Robobees appear from the sides of the level and follow the Kongs' movements through tight corridors. When the Kongs reach the level's final section, the two Robobees that were following them leave and a third one appears, which the Kongs this time have to dodge using springs floating on the lava. Due to the electricity they discharge, Robobees are invulnerable to all of the Kongs' attacks and can only be avoided.

Radiant Peach is one of the many transformations of Princess Peach in Princess Peach: Showtime! Peach can transform into Radiant Peach with the use of the Sparklas' Sparkla Spirits and their love for the Sparkle Theater; this helps Radiant Peach open the door to Grape and the final level, It's Showtime, Grape! Radiant Peach can levitate and summon Sparkla projectiles. While she can fire an infinite amount of projectiles, she is slowed down when firing them, and has to stop firing in order to dodge various obstacles fast enough. It is the only transformation in the game to not have an option to let Stella give control hints.

MegaDragonBowser is the final boss of the Lava Pit in Mario + Rabbids Kingdom Battle and the final boss in the game. It is Bowser possessed by the Megabug. MegaDragonBowser largely resembles Bowser's regular form, with the addition of the Megabug's wings, tail, and orange circuitry patterns on his shell and limbs, and glowing, yellow eyes lacking pupils. His spike rings also lack spikes and glow with the circuitry pattern like the rest of his body. In Mario + Rabbids Sparks of Hope, Cursa creates a copy of Bowser known as Darkmess Bowser, which was enabled from when the Megabug, Cursa's progenitor, possessed Bowser to become MegaDragonBowser. The Dark Longator is an enemy from Super Paper Mario that can be found in rooms 23 and 88 of the Flopside Pit of 100 Trials. It appears as a shadow version of a regular Longator. It attacks by stretching its head out to extreme proportions, reaching the player from a long distance away. However, this makes the now-very-wide enemy easier to step on. A Dark Longator's head can go through the black blocks in the Pit.

Glohm Magikoopas are Magikoopas infected by Glohm in Mario & Luigi: Brothership. They inhabit Wayaway Island, on the path to the engine part, but also appear at Offandon Island, where they are attacking Bowser Jr. and Kamek, and in the Soli-Tree during the first phase of the final battle against Reclusa if Mario and Luigi crash into a Doom Bloom. If they see Mario and Luigi, Glohm Magikoopas will fly at them, occasionally stopping to cast spells at the brothers. Glohm Magikoopas look like normal Magikoopas, but their bodies have a red tint, small red blocky particles emanate from them, and their glasses glow red.

Flurl (known as Ressar in the European English GameCube version) is a Jungle Buddy of Donkey Kong in Donkey Kong Jungle Beat, who first appears in Jungle Deeps. Flurl is a large red squirrel with a giant tail. While usually only one can be seen at a time, two appear on-screen at one point in Ninjape Rally. Flurl occasionally appears sleeping in a tree. If Donkey Kong grabs Flurl's tail, he can use Flurl as parachute and glide through the air. This allows Donkey Kong to collect some Beats while airborne and access normally unreachable areas.

Ecks is a member of the Extension Corps under Zokket in Mario & Luigi: Brothership alongside Ten and Shun. He is a floating, magenta being that wears a yellow cape. Ecks has black eyes with white pupils and a purple horn extending from the back of his head, and his mouth has yellow, square teeth, while his hands are based on fork connectors. The horn on his head and his teeth are based on a LAN/Ethernet cable head. When the Extension Corps are flying, Ecks is the only member to not be carried by a Snaptor, due to him already having the ability to fly. Chase Davenport (formerly known as Subject C) is the smartest of the three super humans. Chase is possibly capable of possessing all bionic abilities, including super strength and super speed, as Douglas Davenport, his father, had mastered the bionic infrastructure. He is one of the five main characters. Chase is the 17-year-old leader of the team with an incredible intelligence rate, super bionic senses, the ability to create force fields around himself as well as specific parts of his body, and use molecularkinesis. It was also shown in Bionic Showdown that he can levitate. His most used ability (besides super intelligence) in Season 4, is his Laser Bo. He is the brother of Adam, Bree, Dan

Vidia is one of the main characters of the Disney Fairies franchise, making her animated debut as the main antagonist of Disney's 2008 film Tinker Bell, and later becoming a supporting protagonist for the rest of the films. She is a sarcastic fast-flying fairy who was once Tinker Bell's rival. After a series of adventures together, however, the two became close friends.

Underdog, also known as Shoeshine, is a canine superhero and the titular protagonist of the live-action film of the same name. He was previously a normal dog until he was exposed to a variety of DNA of different animals, which modifies the beagle's DNA and gives him supernatural powers and abilities (see character infobox). He's able to speak like a regular human. He is also able to emit a bark that is so strong it can shatter glass.
The Skrulls are a race of extremely advanced, shape-shifting aliens that look somewhat like goblins. They were created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Saffron is a flying horse who first appears in the Sofia the First episode "Minimus is Missing", voiced by Kelly Stables. She is Princess Amber's flying horse.
Pedro is a young mail plane, a character and the protagonist from the animated short of the same name segment of the 1943 package film Saludos Amigos.

Miranda is a shape-shifter from the W.I.T.C.H. TV series. Like Cedric, Miranda is a shape-shifter with two forms, one human and one animal. In her human form Miranda is a beautiful, small Asian girl in her early teens, she wears a green and yellow dress and has black hair. In her animal form, she is a hairy four-legged, four-eyed spider-like creature with the power to climb walls and shoot webs. When knocked unconscious, Miranda returns to her human form. While masquerading as a student in Heatherfield, she went by the alias Melinda.
Liam Williams is a supporting character in the Hulu animated series Koala Man. He is the son of the titular protagonist who is slightly geeky and possesses telekinetic and telepathic powers.
Hyper-Potamus is a recurring antagonist in the third and final season of Big Hero 6: The Series. She is a robotic purple hippo who can fly and greets people with a permanent smile.

Houdini, also known as Experiment 604, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to make armies and weapons invisible; unfortunately, he was gun-shy on the battlefield and always ran away and made himself invisible instead. His one true place is as a Hollywood star magician, but his actions have promoted him to a shark tank attraction, where he makes sharks disappear to amaze crowds.

Agent 33 (real name Kara) was a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. She was brainwashed by Daniel Whitehall into serving HYDRA. After agent Grant Ward helped her regain her identity and freedom, she allied herself with Ward. Agent 33 also has the ability to shapeshift due to the Nano Mask.

Basri Ket is a Human, former planeswalker, and sand-mage from Amonkhet. He's a paladin devoted to Oketra, who evangelized the virtue of solidarity. His magic appears as a swirling golden aura of sand.

Tarem is a Dimir agent on the plane of Ravnica. Tarem is a notion thief, able to steal thoughts, memories, and experiences from both the living and the deceased. His eyes and grin are sharp and bright, and he wears mildly extravagant clothing. He appears to be a young man, but his true age may be far older than what it appears.

Lord Magnus was a powerful Dominarian druid and the avatar of the woods on southern Argenti. His physical body was old and weathered, and he resided within the Sylvan Library, from which he could control the growth of all plant life and command all the wildlife in the forest.

Cullinarn was the master of the House of Oor-tael in Estark , on Dominaria, and the father of Garth One-eye. He was tall, red-haired, with beard and mustache cropped short, and wore a circlet of turquoise stones upon his brow. In his youth, he had saved the life of his friend, Grand Master Kuthuman, from an assassin; he carried the marks of that poisoned dagger until his death. He resisted to Kuthuman when the Master of Arena ordered Oor-tael to surrender its blue and green mana, fearing that Kuthuman would become a tyrant after his ascension. The is a Pureblood Heartless that is found in Kingdom Hearts II and Kingdom Hearts Union χ. It hides among regular gargoyle statues, and appears suddenly to attack. It attacks by slashing its sword. It has no legs, is dark blue black in color, horned, and possesses bat-like wings. Slow as they are, Gargoyle Knights are immune to magic spells. They can also fly and swoop down blade-first, making them all the more dangerous.

Ethan grabs his opponents limbs and presses the marma point in their arm, rendering that limb completely useless. It can be used as a counter for incoming attacks, as seen with Ethan's fight against Kenichi.

is the ultimate form of DIO from an Alternate Universe, featured in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Eyes of Heaven as the main antagonist of the game. Originally existing from a Parallel World where he killed the Joestars, this DIO achieved his goal of "obtaining heaven" and as a result, has obtained complete god-like powers and the "ultimate Stand" referred to as The World Over Heaven.

is a primary ally featured in the light novel El Aleph. She is the granddaughter of Loggins and is a skilled Ripple user. She joins the Speedwagon Foundation as a special investigator along with Gustave Shaulo Messina, working under Lisa Lisa. Sasha also gains the Stand El Obsceno Pájaro de la Noche, a flock of birds that she uses for scouting and fighting.

is the Stand of Fabio Ubuh, featured in the light novel El Aleph. It allows Fabio to command flies near him by ordering them where to strike. It can also harden the bodies of the flies, transforming them into lethal "invisible bullets".

The Impaler is a massive with extreme armor that has acquired a unique and powerful adaptation. As if this monster wasn't terrifying enough, it has a head made up of three bladed tentacles which it burrows into the ground to break up a 's attempts at retreating. Impalers will attempt to attack only from a distance or behind cover, as they are meant to be long range units. If faced in close combat, they will attempt to crush you with their large armored claws; if attacked, they will then try to retreat back to cover to burrow again.

Wrizfar Barkfeather, the "First Acolyte of the Conclave, Holy Protector of the Vitar Yescu and Knight of (unknown title)" was an elf leader of the Utvaran settlement of the Selesnya guild. He resided in the Vitar Yescu. Though being treated rudely by Teysa at first, he agreed to participate in her "Guildpact" strike force against Zomaj Hauc. Wrizfar was a skilled shapeshifter, able to shapeshift at least into the forms of a falcon and an elephant. Although his fate is uncertain, he might have been in the Vitar Yescu when it was burned down by the blue dragon.

Thaddeus was one of a pair of Metathran commanders created by Urza as part of his Bloodline project to lead the Dominarian armies during the Phyrexian Invasion. He was the twin of Agnate and the two shared a semi-telepathic bond, which helped coordinate their armies on the battlefield.

Shiko is a spirit dragon native to the plane of Tarkir, affiliated with the Jeskai clan. She embodies the wisdom and discipline of the Jeskai Way while symbolizing the spiritual union between humans and dragons.

Cockatrice was originally a green creature type that was only used once, for the card Cockatrice in Alpha. Cockatrices are flying creatures that can turn their enemies to stone, much like Basilisks. They have lithe, feathery, serpentine bodies with the head of a bird, two legs, and two wings. They are the size of a large horse. In Magic 2014 it finally returned as a black creature (Deathgaze Cockatrice). It was argued that though deathtouch suited both colors, green didn't get flying creatures anymore, making black the easiest fit with both deathtouch and flying. Journey into Nyx added the green/blue Fleetfeather Cockatrice, using blue to justify the flying.

Chromium Rhuell was a famous Elder Dragon with shapeshifting powers. He was long and sleek, his scales had a metallic sheen, and he had confident and curious nature. He was the second of the elders to name himself. He was brother to Merrevia Sal, Nicol Bolas, Arcades Sabboth, Palladia-Mors, and Ugin. He was cousin to Vaevictis Asmadi and Piru, who was also his life partner. With Piru, he was father to Crosis. Chromium was killed by Tevesh Szat at the end of the Ice Age.
Dah'mir is a shapechanging copper dragon and the head priest of a Cult of the Dragon Below and master of the Bonetree Clan of the Shadow Marches.

Arstyvrax is a black dragon and member of the Shadowmasters, a draconic cabal of a dozen dragon necromancers seeking to use the powers of the Shadow against the Undying Court of Aerenal. He is secretly also a vampiric dragon who has a connection to the Blood of Vol.

A kastighur is a type of demon found in the plane of Mabar, the Endless Night. Wicked and sadistic, kastighurs act as prison wardens and hunters among demonkind. They teleport around the field of battle and use their devastating charges to stun and horrify their enemies.

A versatile and heroic character, the druid combines the wonder of natural magic with a fair sense of combat to make a truly unique type of hero. With divine magic granted to them by the natural world or specific nature-focused gods, the druid feels most at home away from civilization where his natural magic can have the most impact. Usually followed by a loyal animal companion, the druid can transform himself into a wild animal taking on all the abilities of the animal while in the beastial form.

Helltime power is the first powerup gained for the Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil's Artifact. It is gained by killing the Helltime Hunter. Helltime is comparable to such abilities as Max Payne's "bullet time", albeit much more advanced. When activated, time slows to a crawl around the player who continues to move quickly. It is necessary to beat two puzzles—a room full of crusher walls and a pathway blocked by fast-moving blades. It is also necessary to beat the Berserk Hunter which moves fast. In Helltime, the player can also out-maneuver monsters, often killing them before they have a chance to strike. Combined with the Berserk punch strength, it can be used to kill many monsters in a hurry.

Virusmon is a Virus Appmon. It is an extremely dangerous being who can create original viruses within its bodies, and the poisons it uses range from fast-acting to slow-acting. Attacks *Purple Gust *Tentacle Bind

Puroromon is a Larva Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It flies freely by individually operating its three pairs of wings. It is not yet powerful, but be that as it may, it is difficult to catch because of its random flying about, which surprisingly gets the opponent completely annoyed. Attacks *Chikkuritto: Injects a tiny quantity of venom with the tiny stinger on its rump.

Puyoyomon is a Lesser Digimon. Puyomon digivolved by taking in jellyfish data. It grew several tentacles by copying the biological features of jellyfish. As you can tell from its round eyes that are brimming with curiosity, it has grown its own preferences, and once it sticks to something that it likes, it will not let go. Even if it likes sticking to something, it will lose interest after a while and detach from it, and has a moody personality where it floats lightly in search of exciting things that suit its taste. Attacks *: Once it sticks to something that it dislikes, it sends out a bursting streak of electricity and never lets anything get near it.

Kotemon is a Reptile Digimon. It is a Digimon that practices kendo with a bamboo sword. Although it doesn't say much, this Digimon works hard in the background. It never removes its armor, and no one has ever seen its true face. Attacks *Hothead (Fire ): Headbutts the enemy with a flaming mask, or a flaming bamboo sword. *Thunder Kote: Charges his fist with electrical current and punches the enemy. *: Pierces with an electric shock. *Thunder Gauntlet

Jazamon is a Bird Dragon Digimon. It is a Machine Digimon shaped like a bird. Although it is capable of gliding from high places using its wings, it is unable to uplift itself by flapping them. As it is quite timid and very cautious, it is wary of objects that move in its surroundings regardless of whether it is day or night. Attacks *Tap-tapping Pick (Kokonpikku): Pecks with its hard beak.

ForgeBeemon is an Cyborg Digimon and a carrier of the X Antibody. It inhabits a mysterious secret honey base in the sky known as the "Royal Base." While Waspmon is in charge of security for the base, ForgeBeemon is tasked with its construction. Its arms are equipped with glue guns, and it uses the honey adhesive created in its abdomen to bond materials together. On occasion, FanBeemon can get stuck to the materials they carry. In such situations, ForgeBeemon can use its auxiliary arms to skillfully rescue them. The Malevolent Tormentor, Spiteful Sprite is a variant of the Treasure Goblin in Diablo III, introduced patch 2.1.2. They have greatly increased chances to drop Legendary Items when killed, scaling with difficulty, up to the point where they are guaranteed to drop those, or even drop more than one. Visually, they have shining bronze appearance. As a possible reference to their name, these Goblins can teleport at will, making catching them especially challenging, even more so when surrounded by other monsters.

Conflux Watch Prime is a Prime Servitor variant within the House of Salvation. It is deployed into battle by Praksis, the Technocrat who developed an interest for the Vex and sent the Servitor to protect the Vex Conflux he built from the Guardians. In order to maintain their conduit into the Vex network, the Prime will teleport players away from the Conflux. It features prominently in the 17th step for the Beyond Light Quest and 2nd step for The Technocrat.

Vandals are a six-limbed class of Eliksni, having a higher ranking than Dregs, but lower than Captains. They bear heavier armor and more deadly weaponry than Dregs. Vandals wield one of four types of weapons: Shock Rifles, mid-range weapons that fire bright blue homing projectiles; Wire Rifles, powerful sniper rifles that take time to charge; Shrapnel Launchers, which fire several projectiles at a time; or dual-wielded Shock Blades. Stealth Vandals, variants of normal Vandals, can use a cloaking ability to render themselves nearly invisible. That role has been since replacing by Marauders at the beginning of the Red War.

Stealth Captains are specialist Fallen Captains, first seen in the House of Wolves. They are outfitted with armor that can support both an Absorption Shield and invisibility tech, which they use to get in close to their foes and keep them engaged.

Zatanna is a powerful stage magician and sorcerer and the daughter of legendary magician Giovanni Zatara. Zatanna is best known for combining her stagecraft with genuine magical capabilities and spellcasting by speaking incantations backwards. She has been a prominent member of the Justice League of America, particularly during its Satellite Era, and a core member of several magic and supernatural-based teams such as the Seven Soldiers of Victory, the Sentinels of Magic, and Justice League Dark. Zatanna's stories often explore the responsibilities and dangers of wielding magic, her relationship with her father, and her connections to fellow heroes and the wider magical community. An invisible stalker is an elemental assassin, summoned from the Elemental Plane of Air to a single purpose given by its master.

Harpies are flying monstrosities with female human and vulture features whose voices can, depending on the type of harpy, charm their prey with an otherworldly song or frighten them with a terrible screech.

The Asgardians, or the Æsir, are the inhabitants of Asgard based on the deities of Norse mythology. They are an ancient race of beings renowned for their many legends and adventures as gods on Earth. Though these godlike beings are peaceful, they are a brave and powerful warrior race whose passion for adventure is their religion. Like the Vikings of Earth, they believe that the only way to gain access into Valhalla (heaven) is to die in glorious battle. Their civilization was built up by, and essentially depends on, magic and sorcery.

They were virtually extinct until 4E 201, when they resurfaced in Skyrim with the return of Alduin the World-Eater in the form of a giant black dragon.

Both the Colossus and the defender were destroyed in the resulting conflict. Buried under a thin layer of dirt, the Colossus was known for centuries as Mount Sardia.

Feral and brutal, she enjoys the hunt and the kill more than the resulting meal. Unlike the other dragons, Kolaghan does not appear to speak draconic, only communicating in lightning flashes and violence.

Logi is a Aesir God who is the embodiment of fire. He is the brother of Ægir, the brother-in-law of Rán and the uncle of the latter two's nine daughters.

She is being pursued by Gwenchaos and his followers because she is one of the four shamans required as sacrifices to resurrect the dark dragon, Gerxel.
Lilith is a non-playable character from Fire Emblem Fates. She is an Astral Dragon that lives in a Shrine in My Castle.

Dral Khatuur, called the Heart of Winter and the Killing Cold, is one of the fiendish Overlords that ruled Eberron during the Age of Demons. She has dominion over cold and winter.
A dracolich is a powerful dragon who has staved off death by becoming a form of undead similar to a lich.

The Devourer of Dreams is the leader of the Circle of Night and the Dreaming Dark as a whole. Also known as The Dreamer, the powerful psionic entity has the ability to commune with the spirits of Dal Quor without being utterly destroyed or absorbed. These spirits guide the Devourer of Dreams' motives, which he then in turn distributes to the other agents of the Dreaming Dark.
Azraxror-Shien is a powerful silver dragon who resides in Argonnessen and is known to be served by a tribe of merchurions that ventured from Xen'drik.

Aboleths are considered one of the earliest evils of Eberron. Born at the dawn of time from the progenitor dragon Khyber, the aboleths followed their Overlords, what they call the Elder Evils, in enslaving the world. These aquatic aberrations used their mind-control abilities to enslave lesser races beneath the seas. However, the Age of Demons came to an end when the dragons and couatls joined forces to defeat the Overlords. The aboleths fled beneath the seas, where their cabals seek to return to their rightful rule of the world.

The Boneyard is the home of the Frost Wyrms, once magnificent dragons now reduced to skeletal frames, manipulated by the dark magic of the Scourge to serve the Lich King. Frost wyrms have a crippling ability to cast their freezing breath onto enemy forces and buildings. In large numbers, frost wyrms present a truly dominating force.
